name: com.nova.tilemap
description: Unity-style 2D tilemaps: a Grid with Tilemap children (GameObject > 2D Object > Tilemap > Rectangular), Tile assets (.tile: a sprite, a color and a collider type), a Tilemap Renderer sorted with Sprite Renderers (Sorting Layer, Order in Layer) and a Tilemap Collider 2D whose touching tiles merge into few boxes. Window Tile Palette: drag a sliced tileset in to make tiles, then paint in the Scene view with Brush (B), Box Fill (U), Picker (I), Eraser (D) and Flood Fill (G); [ and ] rotate, Shift erases. C# Tilemap.SetTile(new Vector3Int(x, y, 0), tile), GetTile, BoxFill, FloodFill, cellBounds, Grid.WorldToCell. Every operation is also a CLI command (nova tilemap <op>).
